name: Keisei-Takasago
tagline: Tokyo in 38 minutes and Otemachi in 38 minutes. Served by 5 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000.
summary: The station is in Katsushika City, where Keisei and Hokuso Railway run 5 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 38 minutes to Otemachi, 52 minutes to Shinjuku, 57 minutes to Shibuya and 51 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. The station stands 1 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 0.8 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 1 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 0.8 m to 1.6 m, a difference of 0.8 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of 3 to 5 m. All nine points within 400 m of the station fall inside the area too, and the deepest projection among them is 3 to 5 m. For storm surge, 9 of the nine points also fall inside the projected area. On the whole, the flood projection here is on the large side for the 23 wards.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 8 clinics and 5 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. No facility recorded as a hospital lies within 2.5 km of the station. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 5 lines serve the station. Keisei Main Line and Keisei Oshiage Line run through it. Keisei Kanamachi Line also call here. Narita Sky Access Line and Hokuso Line are available too. The lines are split between operators (Keisei runs 4 lines and Hokuso Railway runs 1 line), so when one line stops you can change to a line run by a different company.
congestion: Keisei Oshiage Line runs at 157% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 京成曳舟→押上, which this station is not on. Keisei Main Line runs at 137%. Its busiest stretch is 大神宮下→京成船橋, which this station is likewise not on. Hokuso Line runs at 90% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch of the line is 新柴又→京成高砂, which includes this station. Keisei Kanamachi Line and Narita Sky Access Line is not covered by the ministry's congestion survey. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥70,000 to ¥80,000 and 1K ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. 1LDK ¥110,000 to ¥120,000 and 2LDK ¥160,000 to ¥170,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Keisei-Takasago. It takes 7 minutes longer to reach Otemachi than Keisei-Takasago.

neighbours.lead: Aoto is ahead on the number of medical facilities and how easy the shopping is, but Keisei-Takasago is ahead on the number of lines.

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 6 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 1 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself sits inside the area projected to flood in the heaviest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: 5 lines serve the station, and the choice of connections is wider than at most stations in the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the high side.
